question: Is the operative power for world-creation derived from māyā rather than from another lord?
premises: Creation of the world requires operative power
This power is characterized as arising from māyā
No other lord is the source of this operation
inference: The power for world-creation operates from māyā and not from another lord
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of sāmarthya +lakṣaṇān +māyāto is compact and interpretive
plain_english: It operates from māyā, characterized by power, for the creation of the world; thus there is no other lord.
